ran: 20 cases with claude -p "/autocompact" (no argument), which prints the main session's window and its source without an API call, on Opus 5.5: each settings file, --settings, --autocompact and CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW against each other (a2, a6 to a9); a per-model and a top-level window in one file and across files (a3, a4, a5, a16, a18, a20); variable values abc, 50000, 2000000, 200k, 200 and empty (a10 to a14, a19); a settings value of 50000 (a15); --autocompact auto (a17); nothing set (a1).
result: Nothing set gave 1m (default for this model). The order was CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW, then --autocompact, then --settings, local, project and user (a6 to a9); /autocompact labels the flag's window "from settings". In one file the per-model window beat the top-level one (a3). Across files the higher file won, whether it set the per-model or the top-level window (a4 gave the project top-level 200k over the user per-model 300k, a5 the project per-model 300k over the user top-level 200k). A per-model "auto" in a higher file gave the default (a16), and an entry for another model did nothing (a18). The variable values abc and empty were ignored (a10, a19); 50000, 200k and 200 ran at 100k; 2000000 ran at 1m (a11 to a14). A settings value of 50000 was ignored and the default applied (a15). The record shows the window the session reports. In a scratch copy of the harness, fake usage of 600k never triggered compaction under a 200k window, while about 990k did under any window, so the window's effect on compaction in -p is not shown here.
method: dashboard/experiments/harness: claude -p in a throwaway HOME, CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR and project under $TMPDIR, a fake key and ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL on 127.0.0.1. fakeapi.py logs the model, output_config.effort and cache_control ttl of each request and answers 400; for agent cases it first streams one Agent tool call. The harness only allows requests to fakeapi.py on 127.0.0.1. Managed settings were not tested, because writing them needs admin rights.
